item.title: Government Minister says €800 charge for adults on chartered flight from Oman was subsidised
item.description: A Government Minister says the €800 charge for adults availing of the chartered flight from Oman was subsidised. This charge was criticised by Social Democrats Senator Patricia Stephenson who called it a shake-down and not an evacuation. This flight is for people who need to get home from the Middle East. item.title: Pedestrian who was critically injured in Ardfert hit-and-run has died
item.description: A man who was critically injured in a hit-and-run in Ardfert has died. The collision, involving the man who'd been walking on the road, and a car occurred on Monday night in the Tubrid More area. The pedestrian, a man in his 30s, was seriously injured in this collision which happened around 9.20pm on Monday. item.description: The main beneficiaries for this year's Ring of Kerry Charity Cycle have been announced. item.title: Kerry County Museum to be closed to public as it undergoes significant works
item.description: Kerry County Museum is to be closed to the public as it undergoes significant structural works. Councillors in the Tralee Municipal District (MD) unanimously approved the €10.4 million upgrade restoration and upgrade of the Ashe Memorial Hall last July The plan is intended to restore the building’s 1920s architecture and will also include new measures to make the building more accessible and energy efficient. item.title: Court hears Tralee man poured petrol on former friend’s neck before lighting on fire
item.description: A court has heard that a Tralee man poured petrol on the neck of a former school friend and lit it on fire while he slept. Tralee Circuit Court judge Ronan Munro said there was no explanation from 32-year-old Tadhg Moran of 44 Mitchels Road, Tralee, as to why he set a human being on fire with petrol.
